build: $$(dotnet build src/DINOForge.CI.sln -c Release --nologo --verbosity quiet > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail)
test: $$(dotnet test src/DINOForge.CI.sln --no-build --nologo --verbosity quiet > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail)
lint: $$(dotnet format src/DINOForge.CI.sln --verify-no-changes --nologo > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail)
audit: $$(command -v cargo-audit > /dev/null && (cd src/Tools/AssetPipelineRust && cargo audit --deny unmaintained --deny unsound > /dev/null 2>&1) && echo pass || echo skip)
deny: $$(command -v cargo-deny > /dev/null && cargo deny --manifest-path src/Tools/AssetPipelineRust/Cargo.toml check > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo skip)
